title: Gracie Abrams 2026-2027: Here’s Where to Shop Affordable Look at My Life Tour Tickets Online
summary: Starting on Dec. 2, the singer-songwriter hits the road with 33 tour dates across the United States.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Gracie Abrams is on the road this winter in support of her third album Daughter from Hell . Starting at Ball Arena in Denver, Colorado on Wednesday (Dec. 2), the tour has more than 30 dates throughout the United States with dates in Los Angeles, Seattle, Chicago, Atlanta, Philadelphia and other cities. It ends with four dates at Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York in March 2027.

The tour features a rotating lineup of openers in support of the singer-songwriter, including Rachel Chinouriri, Holly Humberstone, Del Water Gap, Charlotte Lawrence, Grace Ives, Bella Kay, Jensen McRae and The Japanese House.

Shop Gracie Abrams Tour Tickets At Ticketmaster

Tickets to the tour first went on sale through Live Nation and Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets.

However, many of the dates have either sold out or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find Gracie Abrams tickets online is through third-party sites, such as StubHub , Vivid Seats , SeatGeek , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All online retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for your concert. Prices may be above or below face value at times.

Where to Find Gracie Abrams: The Look at My Life Tour 2026-2027 Tickets Online

EDITOR'S PICK

Find Gracie Abrams Tickets at StubHub

Top choice for concert tickets.

StubHub has all-in pricing, so all fees are listed upfront. The site’s “FanProtect Guarantee” ensures that tickets are valid and delivered in time for the concert. If not, you’ll get your money back. In addition, if the concert is canceled and not rescheduled, you’ll receive 120% credit or be offered a full refund without the extra credit. At the time of publishing, Gracie Abrams tickets start at $30.

Tickets are delivered digitally via email, so they’re available on your phone before you go through security. And prices are surprisingly reasonable, even for the hottest tickets. For example, SeatGeek has cheap Gracie Abrams tickets online from $29. Use our discount code BILLBOARD10 to save an additional $10 at checkout.

Find Gracie Abrams Tickets at TicketNetwork

find tickets at TicketNetwork

TicketNetwork has ticket packages, which include parking passes, VIP access, meet and greets and other great experiences. It has tickets to Gracie Abrams concerts with all-in pricing that lets you see exactly what you’ll pay up front (fees included). Tickets start at $36, as of this writing. You can use our exclusive code BILLBOARD150 to save $150 off purchases over $500, or BILLBOARD300 to save $300 off orders of $1000 and up.

And since TicketNetwork is a resale site, the company says that pricing may sometimes be below face value because tickets aren’t held to a specific price point. It guarantees that the tickets you receive are the ones you purchased, and sometimes, even better than expected.

Gametime is a stellar third-party retailer for fans looking for affordable tickets. Tickets for in-demand concerts like Gracie Abrams start at $28. It guarantees the lowest prices, event cancellation protection and on-time ticket delivery for a smooth ticket-buying experience.
